Affordable Healthcare with Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi
Today, many people cannot get the healthcare they need because it is too expensive. Millions cannot afford life-saving treatment. A NITI Aayog report says
that 30% of the population lacks financial support for medical care.
Health insurance helps some people, but many poor families still cannot afford it. That’s why government initiatives such as Kerala’s Karunya Arogya
Suraksha Padhathi (KASP) aim to change this by focusing on making healthcare affordable and accessible while addressing inequality in the system.

What is the Karunya Health Insurance Scheme?
The Karunya Health Insurance Scheme (KASP) is a Kerala government initiative to help low-income families access affordable healthcare. It provides
financial support for costly medical treatments, which helps make quality healthcare more accessible while reducing medical expenses.
Overview Of The Karunya Health Insurance Scheme
Scheme Name  Karunya Health Insurance
Launch Year 2012
Coverage Medical expenses
Eligibility Kerala residents
Health Conditions All conditions covered
Main Objective Financial safety
Aim  Affordable treatment
Age Limit No age restrictions

Aims of Karunya Insurance
Here is the list of the main objectives of KASP insurance:
Offers financial assistance to individuals with critical illnesses and helps them manage medical expenses.
Make sure that people throughout Kerala can get high-quality healthcare services.
Supports individuals and families struggling with the financial burden of critical illnesses.
Provides extensive coverage for a wide variety of critical illnesses as well as medical treatments.
Facilitates healthcare accessibility for economically disadvantaged populations, enabling them to prioritize recovery without the burden of financial
concerns.
Also Check: Corporate Medical Insurance
Essential Features of Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi
Here are the standout features of the KASP Scheme:
The government fully provides this scheme.
Offers hospitalisation coverage of up to 5 lakhs per household annually.
Cashless medical care is also availableat the listed hospitals.
The scheme generally helps to reduce the burden of high medical expenses.
There are no gender, age, or family size restrictions.
Pre-existing diseases are also covered from day one of the treatment.
It is even available at both public and private hospitals across India.
It provides comprehensive benefits while covering 1,573 procedures, which mainly include surgeries, diagnostics, medications, and more.

Listed below are the benefits provided by the KASP scheme:
Offers up to 2 lakhs for specific illnesses and increases to 3 lakhs for severe cases.
Generally covers extra costs if treatment expenses exceed the initial estimate.
Scheme benefits usually extend to at least 5 family members, each with a unique ID card for availing medical services.
Cashless Hospitalisation
Treatment for chronic and critical illnesses.
Coverage for diagnostics and medications during and after treatment
Coverage of Karunya Health Insurance
The Karunya Health Insurance Scheme covers a wide range of healthcare treatments, including:
Cardiac treatments (angioplasty, bypass surgery, valve replacement)
Cancer treatments (radiation therapy, chemotherapy, surgery)
Emergency trauma care and accident treatments
Coverage for maternity and neonatal care
Neurological disorders (brain surgeries, stroke management)
Renal diseases (dialysis, kidney transplant)
Orthopaedic procedures (joint replacement, fracture surgeries)
Liver and lung diseases
Facilities Under Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi
The Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi offers a variety of services that are specially designed to provide comprehensive health coverage for those facing
critical illnesses. These are some of the main benefits offered by this health insurance scheme:
●  Critical Illness Support: The scheme offers essential treatment for individuals suffering from severe diseases.
●  Financial Aid: Enrolled individuals can receive up to 2 lakhs for treatment, with the amount increasing to 3 lakhs for more severe conditions.
●  Expense Reimbursement: Beneficiaries are also eligible for reimbursement in case the treatment cost exceeds the original estimate.

4/12
●  Family Benefits: The scheme mainly covers up to 5 family members, with each receiving a special card for accessing medical services.
●  Wide Illness Coverage: It even offers coverage for a wide variety of critical illnesses, which mainly include heart diseases, cancer, kidney diseases,
and more.
●  Accessible Hospitals: The program now encompasses both government and private hospitals equipped with advanced technology, thereby
increasing access to quality healthcare.
All of these facilities ensure financial as well as medical support for economically disadvantaged individuals during critical illnesses.
Also Read: 1 Crore Health Insurance
Eligibility Criteria For Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi
Individuals must meet the following criteria to become eligible for the Karunya Arogya Suraksha scheme:
1. Applicants must reside in Kerala.
2. The scheme is available to individuals who fall below the poverty line (BPL).
3. Families earning less than ₹ 3 lakhs per year are eligible, regardless of whether they are classified as BPL or above the poverty line (APL).
4. Applicants are required to submit their income certificate, Aadhaar card, and any other necessary documents.
Documents Required for Karunya Health Insurance Scheme Application
Here is the list of the essential documents that are required for the KASP scheme:
●  Voter ID card/Aadhar card
●  Passport-sized photograph
●  Ration card
●  Income Certificate – This helps to determine eligibility based on annual income. An individual must also ensure to keep all income-related
documents handy.
●  Address Proof – Beneficiaries should submit the original copy of their residential proof.
●  BPL Card – Applicants must confirm that they are eligible as underprivileged individuals. If you have a BPL card, you need to submit it when applying
online.

KASP Apply Online: Steps to Follow
Here are some easy steps for KASP insurance registration online:
Step 1: Visit the official website:
Step 2: Click on "How to Apply" and download the application form.
Step 3: Fill out the form with the required details and submit it along with the necessary documents.
Step 4: Track the application status for the KASP insurance card check online using the "Application Tracking" feature.
Individuals can also check the name in the "List of Beneficiaries" on the homepage.
Also Check: Affordable Health Insurance
How to Find a Hospital Covered by the Karunya Health Insurance Scheme?
Individuals should follow these steps to find a hospital that accepts the Karunya Health Insurance Scheme:
1. Visit the Official Website: The individual should go to the Kerala State Government’s health insurance website or the provider’s website.
2. Check the List of Network Hospitals: They must look for the list of empanelled hospitals that are usually found under sections like "Hospital List"
or similar
3. Contact Customer Service: If beneficiaries can’t find the information online, they can simply reach out to customer service for a list of hospitals.
4. Visit Local Health Offices: They can even visit local health offices or the district health department to get details on covered hospitals.
5. Consult Insurance Agent: In case a person has an insurance agent, they can also help them locate the list of hospitals under the scheme.
Hospitalization Process Under the Karunya Health Insurance Scheme
Here are some easy steps to avail of hospitalization under KASP insurance:
The individual must first ensure that the hospital is listed under the Karunya Health Insurance Scheme.
They should present their KASP insurance card download or details at the hospital’s admissions desk.
The hospital verifies the coverage and initiates the claim process.
Treatments are covered according to the scheme’s guidelines during the hospital stay.

The person should coordinate with the hospital’s insurance or billing department to ensure a smooth process for any required approvals or
documentation.
The Karunya Health Insurance Scheme is an excellent example of a government initiative focused on providing affordable healthcare to everyone. It has
positively impacted many lives in Kerala with its comprehensive coverage and financial support.
Hence, the KASP scheme makes a big step towards providing accessible and affordable healthcare for everyone.
